lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Good afternoon. Welcome to our restaurant. How many people?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: What can I get you to drink?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Are you ready to order your food?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: We'd like fish and rice, please.

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: I'm sorry, we're out of fish today. Would chicken be okay?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, chicken and rice would be fine.
